source.heading: Part V: Disposition and Offers > Signals

rows.name: Warning
rows.text: It warns you off something it cares about. Write the warning as a crumb in the Report.

rows.name: Offer
rows.text: It proposes a deal, drawn from its objective. Answer at your next Offer step. Refusing an Open or Allied AA costs −1 disposition.

rows.name: Exposure
rows.text: It has overextended. Name the vulnerability in the Report.

rows.name: Windfall
rows.text: Its action this turn incidentally helps you. Write it as an unintended consequence.
